test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following continents does the Union Pacific Railroad operate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North America.**__

__
 
• the Union Pacific Railroad operates in **North America.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thomas Clark Durant,** the namesake of the city of Durant, Iowa, the first rails were laid in Omaha. 
 
• The two lines were joined at Promontory Summit, Utah, 53 miles (85 km) west of Ogden on May 10, 1869, hence creating the first transcontinental railroad in **North America**. __
 
• President **Abraham Lincoln** had approved the act.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

There are seven continents: **Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia** (listed from largest to smallest in size).
